name: hxnsl
description: Shaders written in Haxe, compiled during the build to WGSL, MSL, HLSL, SPIR-V and GLSL ES.
releasenote: First release: HXSL shaders compiled during the Haxe build to WGSL, MSL, HLSL, SPIR-V and GLSL ES, with their layouts and binding slots as constants, and targets that GPU drivers register. The tool is prebuilt for macOS, Linux and Windows.
